lede: AK Workshop is a car workshop in Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2. Its own website lists engine repairs, servicing and oil changes, ECU works and EV and hybrid repairs.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention long-time servicing since 2012, suspension noise fixed for less than another quote, magic collar installs, BMW work and repairs on an older Porsche Boxster.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, akworkshop.com.
makes_note: Named by customers on Google Maps. Ask the workshop about other makes.
